title: AI-ILC Data
description: Family-scoped (ideas funnel) data shape for AI-ILC (Idea Life Cycle).

items.description: Idea funnel item for the dashboard Ideas tab (BUILD_GUIDE §2.2). Renderer filters on lowercase `stage`.

status.description: Layer-1 PascalCase status (kept for back-compat); `stage` is its lowercase form

aiLens.description: AI-LENS fields (AI_LENS_PROTOCOL §6.2 — AI-ILC contract). Present only when the idea carries an AI posture.

aiPosture.description: AI posture recorded on the Idea Brief: no-ai | opportunity | augmented | native

aiCapabilitySignal.description: High-level AI capability type signal from the §5 taxonomy (e.g. generation, recommendation)

aiFeatureId.description: Stable thread identifier (AIF-{NNN}) minted when the idea is AI-specific; null if not AI

automationLens.description: Automation-LENS fields (AUTOMATION_LENS_PROTOCOL §6.2 — AI-ILC contract). Present only when the idea carries an Automation posture.

automationPosture.description: Automation posture recorded on the Idea Brief: manual | assisted | attended | unattended

automationPatternSignal.description: High-level automation pattern type signal from the §5 taxonomy (e.g. workflow-orchestration, routing-assignment)

automationFeatureId.description: Stable thread identifier (AUTO-{NNN}) minted when the idea is automation-specific; null if not automation
